caption: The drawing depicts a toy cow that is orange with patches of white and brown scattered across its body, positioned standing on a green platform that has four dark gray wheels attached to it. The cow has a curled tail, pointed ears, and is facing towards the left side of the image. The wheels are evenly spaced beneath the platform, with visible spokes. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner that reads "Stanley K. Chin."
title: Toy Animal
